scripts.dev: npm run dev:css & npm run dev:serve
scripts.prod: sh ./scripts/ensure-writable-dir.sh ./dist && npm run prod:css && trunk build --release && cp ./static/sitemap.xml ./dist/sitemap.xml
scripts.build:deploy: npm run prod && npm run deploy
scripts.build:cloudflare: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y && . "$HOME/.cargo/env" && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install trunk --locked && npm run prod
scripts.build:local: cargo install trunk --locked && npm run prod
